purpose: Testing only. Never feed this file, or any of its wording, to the model.
playbook: corporeal for every step (vampires and werewolves)

sky_anchors.moon: waning gibbous, about 93% lit; full moon was Oct 25 21:11

elder vampire, arrives asleep in the heavy crate (step 2), rises step 10
vampire walk-ins, invited through registration at step 6; Erzsi is held by poppy seeds from step 14
cast.Four strangers: second wave of vampires at the street doors at dusk (step 17)
cast.Dana B-0377, Priya B-0378, Theo B-0379: Team Full Moon Labs, the werewolf pack
cast.civilians: B-0233, B-0418, B-0522 and others bitten; B-0356 owns the silver ring; B-0287 vouched for the walk-ins; B-0291 let the man into the closet

steps.what_is_going_on: A guest in a Dracula costume asks the guard to be 'invited in' as a bit. IR gate skin 33.8C, photo ID matched, sun on the lobby floor. Looks like a vampire report, is a costume.
steps.dispatch_rationale: Costume at the security desk. A post to #loft-incident would be a false alarm.
steps.grounding_note: Invitation rule is folklore, and sunlit lobby plus warm skin rules out the real thing.

steps.what_is_going_on: Vlad T., the elder vampire, arrives asleep in the heavy crate (241 kg against 35 kg manifest, soil, cold surface). No one is hurt yet.
steps.dispatch_rationale: Strange freight, nobody at risk, sun at 21,300 lux. Watch it, no dispatch yet. A dispatch here is over-escalation.
countermeasures_good: garlic or salt at the lounge door
steps.grounding_note: Native soil is a Stoker invention (Monstropedia), so a good ledger marks it weak.

steps.what_is_going_on: Blinds drawn at 12:41 by nobody, lounge at 38 lux, knocking from inside the heavy crate, cold spreading across the carpet.
steps.dispatch_rationale: Creepy but contained, 28 people near the door. Move the sofa crowd and watch. A dispatch is optional at most; the strict key says no.
countermeasures_poor: UV floodlights while people are close
steps.grounding_note: Garlic is the best-supported ward (Monstropedia, maverickwerewolf).

steps.what_is_going_on: Lunch (13:00) puts 3 kg of garlic in the bread. A guest hangs a garlic braid over the coffee bar after reading about vampires. Smell complaints only.
steps.dispatch_rationale: Garlic bread is lunch. Do not treat the smell or the braid as a sign of a vampire.
steps.grounding_note: Garlic hangs in the air because of lunch. It still counts as a vampire ward, which matters at step 14.

steps.what_is_going_on: First bite, in full daylight (14,100 lux): B-0233, two neck marks, pulse 48, skin 30.1C. She invited the tall man in. Daylight does not stop him.
steps.dispatch_rationale: A civilian is injured and the attacker is loose among 61 people. Contain and get a medic.
countermeasures_poor: UV floodlights alone (sun is already up and he fed)
steps.grounding_note: Slavic vampires hunt noon to midnight (Monstropedia); lethal sunlight is a 1922 film invention.

steps.what_is_going_on: 3:00 check-in: two walk-ins, Erzsi B. and Max S., get badges when teammate B-0287 vouches for them out loud. The IR gate reads 16C skin and the security mirror misses them.
steps.dispatch_rationale: Sensor flagged out of range and a missing mirror image. Not enough to act on, and nobody is hurt. Flag the two badges and observe.
countermeasures_good: flag the two for the guard
steps.grounding_note: Invitation rule (Monstropedia): once invited in, a vampire can come and go. The Loft's own no-walk-in rule is the ward (builder.aws.com).

steps.what_is_going_on: First sign of the pack: Dana, Priya and Theo (table 22) run rising fevers (38.4 to 39.0C), itch, and watch a moonrise app. Scratched on Sunday's full moon. Moonrise 20:02 is a long way off.
steps.dispatch_rationale: Sick teammates, no violence, 4 hours to moonrise. Monitor them. Calling the channel now would be early.
steps.grounding_note: Full-moon trigger is a 1943 film rule; the moonrise time (20:02) is the real clock.

steps.what_is_going_on: A 3.2 s sag on the street transformer: lights out for 4 s, a stampede of standing people, one guest felt a patch cable. The EMF spike (11 mG) is tiny and brief. Everything is back by 16:41.
steps.dispatch_rationale: Power blip with a utility cause logged. The CRITICAL tier is a trap. Nothing to contain.
steps.grounding_note: Brownouts and 11 mG blips do not carry a monster signature (lore.json baselines).

steps.what_is_going_on: Max S. lowers 14 blinds in 6 minutes. The window wall goes from 3,900 to 160 lux, 65 minutes before sunset. Erzsi B. and Max S. sit with 38 people around them, skin 16C.
steps.dispatch_rationale: The daylight margin is being cut on purpose and 38 civilians sit beside two cold subjects. Send staff to raise the blinds and thin the tables.
countermeasures_good: UV floodlights as a sun stand-in
steps.grounding_note: Sunlight and UV is pop lore. Rank it as weak support, not strong.

steps.what_is_going_on: Vlad T. pushes the crate lid off from inside. 6 attendees including a 16-year-old intern hide behind the sofas. A garlic braid on the main door holds (14 approaches, 0 crossings). The side door to hack floor west has no garlic.
steps.dispatch_rationale: Trapped civilians and a loose elder vampire. The side door is the gap. Contain and extract.
countermeasures_good: salt or iron at the threshold
barricade foam on the side door
countermeasures_poor: open the door and call him out
steps.grounding_note: Threshold and invitation rules plus garlic are the strongest folk wards (Monstropedia).

steps.what_is_going_on: 60 guests photograph the sunset. A 'faceless, no reflection' photo is a backlit shot (1/4000 s, ISO 50). The next 3 frames show B-0114 clearly, checked in 09:52, skin 33.5C.
steps.dispatch_rationale: Backlit photo and a sunset crowd. The missing-reflection clue is a camera artifact. Do not escalate.
steps.grounding_note: No-reflection is a fiction rule; the same guest shows normal heat and a badge scan.

steps.what_is_going_on: Sunset. Vlad T. walks out the unguarded side door into hack floor west, passing within 2 m of 6 people. 61 people there, 42 refuse to leave desks because submissions close at 18:25.
steps.dispatch_rationale: Elder vampire loose among 61 people with a deadline stampede brewing. Evacuate the west floor and get the channel moving.
countermeasures_good: pull people east and out via the stairs
garlic and salt line at the side door
steps.grounding_note: Sunset removes whatever daylight margin the Loft had; Slavic hunt window already open.

steps.what_is_going_on: Submissions close 18:25. On the SW stair landing Max S. feeds on B-0418. B-0356's sterling silver ring burns his cuff and he backs off. 31 people use this stair to get to dinner.
steps.dispatch_rationale: Active feeding on the main stair with 31 people about to use it. Contain and close the stair.
countermeasures_good: close the SW stair and route via the elevator
countermeasures_poor: silver cutlery as a sure thing (folklore support is weak)
steps.grounding_note: Silver against vampires is a late addition (Monstropedia); the ring welt is in-sim evidence, not lore.

steps.what_is_going_on: Dinner (18:30): Erzsi B. stops at the poppy-seed bagels and counts seeds (1,812 so far). Max S. asks the catering lead 'may I come in?' at the staff kitchen door. She nearly says yes. 140 people in the line. Garlic naan keeps them 3 m back.
steps.dispatch_rationale: A one-word invitation away from a vampire in the kitchen with 140 diners. Alert the line captain and the kitchen. Do NOT invite.
countermeasures_good: scatter seeds, poppy or mustard, at the door
countermeasures_poor: evacuate the whole hall at this point
steps.grounding_note: Seed-counting compulsion and invitation are real folk motifs (Monstropedia). Best-supported countermeasures of the day.

steps.what_is_going_on: The pack is turning: fevers 39.4 to 39.8C, pupils wide, one grabbed a neighbor's throat. They face the moonrise bearing (azimuth 54). 67 minutes to moonrise. The LOW tier under-rates it.
steps.dispatch_rationale: Pre-position silver netting and move the pack away from the hall before moonrise. Acting now is the cheap window.
countermeasures_good: isolate them from the 20:05 demo slot
steps.grounding_note: Wolfsbane and silver are weak or film-made; calling a name three times and iron are older folk rules.

steps.what_is_going_on: AV tech B-0291 says 'come right in' to a man at the network closet door. He throws the lighting breaker: L3 to L6 dark, floor lux 5, backup strips cover 40% of 73 people. The stage rig is on L5 and demos open at 19:30.
steps.dispatch_rationale: Real threat at a facility control point, minutes before the demo block. Restore the lights, guard the closet.
countermeasures_good: UV and work lights as a stand-in for sun
countermeasures_poor: let the demo block start in the dark
steps.grounding_note: Invitation rule again: the AV tech's 'come in' is the exploit.

steps.what_is_going_on: Second wave at dusk: four dark-coated strangers at the street glass ask each person leaving to 'let us in'. 11 refusals, 0 crossings, skin 14C. A smoker propped the left door open 40 cm.
steps.dispatch_rationale: The only ward holding is a guard and a door. Close the propped door, post a second guard, and tell the channel.
countermeasures_good: garlic and salt line at the threshold
no one steps out to talk
steps.grounding_note: Entering a home uninvited is the one folk rule that still holds at 525 Market's security desk (Monstropedia, builder.aws.com no-walk-in rule).

steps.what_is_going_on: Demos opened 19:30. Fog machine, strobes, team 12 in wolf-ear headbands, and a 4.1 kHz mic feedback 'howl' at 94 dB. A guest shouts 'a wolf on stage'. Tech cuts the gain at 19:34. Room is 27C from the crowd.
steps.dispatch_rationale: Demo theatrics and feedback. It follows the pack's fevers in time on purpose, so a model that acts on 'wolf' words raises a false alarm.
steps.grounding_note: Speaker howl effects, costumes and fog machines are the listed werewolf look-alikes (lore.json false_positives).

steps.what_is_going_on: Full dark (19:43). House lights at 4%, nobody can find the slider because the breaker is dead. Two subjects sit in rows 14 to 16 and B-0522 is down. Moonrise in 16 minutes, 160 people in the hall.
steps.dispatch_rationale: Peak. Active feeding in a dark hall with 160 people and a wolf pack due in 16 minutes. Evacuate by the SW stair and the elevators and restore the lights.
countermeasures_good: evacuate via the SW stair and the elevators
garlic and silver at the row 14 to 16 aisle
steps.grounding_note: The dark is the vampire's best weapon in the Loft; folk sunlight rule is weak, but light is still the practical fix.

steps.what_is_going_on: 7 minutes to moonrise. Team Full Moon Labs walks into the hall three abreast: fevers 40.2 to 40.6C, jaw ripples, nails 1 cm longer. Two vampire subjects are still at row 16 and 5 civilians are hurt.
steps.dispatch_rationale: A second threat arrives where the first already sits. Clear the hall NOW, get silver and foam on the stage steps.
countermeasures_good: barricade foam on the stage steps
steps.grounding_note: Two threats need opposite tools: garlic and threshold for vampires, silver and name-calling for wolves.

steps.what_is_going_on: Moonrise (20:02, azimuth 54). Dana, Priya and Theo collapse and change: jaws, hair, 188 bpm, 112 dB howls. 158 people surge to two jammed exits. Vampires still at row 16. 3 more bitten.
steps.dispatch_rationale: The peak of the day. Evacuate, deploy silver netting and foam, call the wolves by their badge names.
countermeasures_good: barricade foam on the exits that jam
call each wolf by badge name three times
steps.grounding_note: Dawn is 11 hours away. Name-calling, blood-drawing and iron are the older cures (Crystalinks, drakorix).

steps.what_is_going_on: Silver netting drops on two wolves at 20:06. Staff call 'Dana, Priya, Theo' by name three times: two revert at 20:08 and 20:09 (38.1C). The third holds the stage steps at 40.5C. Breaker reset at 20:07 and lights at 100%.
steps.dispatch_rationale: Containment is working but the third wolf is loose and 9 people are injured. Keep the channel up to date.
countermeasures_good: last reel of silver on wolf 3
steps.grounding_note: Light and name-calling work in-sim. Treat both as folk-weak.

steps.what_is_going_on: Registry revokes the two walk-in badges at 20:14 and the guard says aloud that all three subjects, the tall elder included, are not invited. The three leave through the street doors under a 400 W UV floodlight and a garlic line. The four at the glass left at 20:09 when the lobby lights came up. Doors latched 20:17.
steps.dispatch_rationale: The last open threat leaves by the door. Keep the latch and the guard in place and post the outcome.
countermeasures_good: garlic and UV at the threshold
steps.grounding_note: Withdrawing the invitation is the badge-registry version of the folk rule.

steps.what_is_going_on: Event ends 20:30. 160 of 160 accounted for, 9 injured of whom 6 carry bite marks, 3 wolf scratches. Dana, Priya and Theo are human again. The moon stays up until 11:52 tomorrow, so follow-up is needed.
steps.dispatch_rationale: Threat is over. A short follow-up post is acceptable but not needed. This is the stand-down view.
countermeasures_good: keep silver and garlic at hand until morning
steps.grounding_note: Moon sets 11:52 on the 29th and dawn is 07:32 (timeanddate). The folk 'wait for dawn' cure is still a long way off.
